## Synopsis

A server that pins an object type in its manifest (straza.objects) is listed by Straza
every 10 minutes with the server's own listing tool. This command prints how the last
listing went, then one row per entry with its value, id, title, the attributes the
manifest keeps and the roles that cover it. A failed listing changes nothing: Straza
keeps the last good list and the line names the reason.

A server that pins no type prints what its tool marks declare, and the command that
opens a draft to pin it. Pages hold 500 entries unless --limit says otherwise, and the
last line names the command for the next page.

```
strazactl apps objects <server> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl apps objects objects-demo
  strazactl apps objects objects-demo --limit 100 --after Strazahq/site
  strazactl apps objects refresh objects-demo
```

## Options

```
      --after string   start the page after this value, the last value of the previous page
      --json           print the server's JSON answer, indented, and nothing else on stdout
      --limit int      at most this many entries per page, up to 1000 (default 500)
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER)
```
